recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-16022 unless a future work group decision changes whether _list should apply to system history or changes the caveat around moving List membership.
issue_request: FHIR-16022 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-I change request asking to support the _list parameter on the resource type _history interaction, with possible global _history use noted. The final resolution was Persuasive with Modification: allow the parameter, but note the problems that can arise from using it.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 5b84d7b8da426d82a56c1b79009928471d500153 (svn revision 14051), which added _list to the history interaction parameter table in source/http.html and added a caveat about repeated periodic queries while List membership changes. A later typo-only cleanup fixed the original 'Thereis' typo without removing the caveat.
additional_context: source/navigation.xml lists REST (HTTP) as an active implementation page, so source/http.html is in current build scope. Current source/http.html describes the shared history interaction for instance, type, and system history URLs; its parameter table includes _list with List/current-list semantics, and the following caveat still warns about omitted older/later changes when List membership changes over time. Later history-parameter clarification work, including FHIR-35781, reformatted and clarified the table while preserving the _list row. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-16022 discussion or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current REST source already implements the approved behavior and caveat for the current build. Adding more local prose would duplicate the existing warning rather than change implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: Clarified the history parameter table and retained the _list row with a link to search _list semantics.
